noProject.prompt: Create a new project to get started
noProject.description: You need a project before you can start recording. Your recordings and documentation steps will be saved inside the project.

bookmark.title: Press F10 to mark documentation steps
bookmark.description: Mark important moments while recording. Each bookmark becomes a documentation step with an auto-extracted screenshot.

preview.selectPrompt: Select a source from the sidebar
preview.clickPrompt: Click "Preview Source" to see what you'll record

coach.sourceDesc: Choose a full screen or a specific window. Click a tile to select it — you'll see a blue border on the chosen source.
coach.startDesc: When ready, click this button to begin capturing. You can pause or stop anytime from the same spot.
coach.stopDesc: Stopping sends you straight to the editor with your recording and all F10 bookmarks ready to turn into steps.
coach.bookmarkDesc: While recording, press F10 whenever something important happens. Each press becomes a documentation step with an auto screenshot.
coach.settingsDesc: Expand Settings to change resolution, frame rate, or enable your microphone before recording.
